name: Confederacies
overview: The Scriptures reveal that confederacies were alliances formed among kings to pursue common military goals, often in response to perceived threats. For example, Genesis 14 describes a coalition of kings waging war against other city-states, while Joshua 10 shows King Adonizedek of Jerusalem uniting with neighboring kings to confront the city of Gibeon for allying with Israel. These instances highlight how such confederacies were strategic and reactive, reflecting the political realities of the ancient world.
